long_biography.plain_text:
An early interest in coding led Mandel to launch his first commercial project from college. His business combined customized applications with cameras, access controls and emergency communications, serving school districts, municipalities and law-enforcement agencies. Products such as One-Button Lockdown and ALERT sought to cut the delay between recognizing a threat and coordinating a response, while repeated Inc. 5000 recognition documented sustained expansion.

A private-equity recapitalization transferred 70 per cent of the operation in 2019, leaving Mandel with a minority position and an executive role. After stepping away from daily management, he pursued consulting, investing and fresh software projects. At XSponse, his present work integrates automated detection, wearable devices, real-time alerts and responder communications into a unified safety platform.
